headline: Bank of Ireland Increases Interest Rates Across Fixed-Term Deposit Products
summary: Bank of Ireland announced an immediate increase in interest rates offered across its range of fixed-term retail and commercial savings accounts.
why: Deposit pricing adjustments by Ireland's major lenders impact retail funding costs and net interest margins.

impacts.name: Bank of Ireland Group
impacts.why: Higher deposit rates attract household savings but exert upward pressure on liability funding costs.
